hints.title: What makes two words equivalent?
hints.body: Ignore the order of the letters. Two words are anagrams exactly when every letter of the alphabet appears the same number of times in both. What compact value could represent those counts?

hints.title: Build a hashable signature
hints.body: Sorting a word's letters produces a signature shared by all of its anagrams: `"listen"` and `"silent"` both become `"eilnst"`. A 26-element count array converted to a string or tuple is an alternative signature.

hints.title: Group first, order later
hints.body: Use a hash map from signature to the list of words that produce it. After every word has been placed, sort each list. Then sort the lists by their first element so the outer order is fixed. Keep duplicate words; do not use a set.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
groups = empty map from signature to list of words
for each word in words:
    signature = sorted letters of word
    append word to groups[signature]

result = empty list
for each group in groups:
    sort group lexicographically
    append group to result

sort result by the first word of each group
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Handle the empty word and the empty input list explicitly when you translate it.
